name: Cyient DLM Ltd
tagline: Aerospace/defense-focused electronics system design and manufacturing (EMS) player riding India's defense-localization tailwind, but with sub-benchmark capital efficiency (ROE 7.5%, ROCE 10.4%) and a stock already up ~3x off its 52-week low - growth without yet the returns to support a screen thesis.
business_overview: Cyient DLM (majority-owned by Cyient Ltd) provides system design, integration, testing and manufacturing of electronic components and subsystems for OEMs, concentrated in aerospace and defense (e.g. an aerospace wiring-harness business with Honeywell as a key customer, and a Boeing 787 Dreamliner order won in 2024). fundamentals_narrative: Cyient DLM is growing revenue well ahead of the EMS industry (~24% CAGR vs ~3% industry median), consistent with genuine share gains in aerospace/defense electronics manufacturing - a structural, policy-backed tailwind (Make in India / defense localization). The catch is capital efficiency: both ROE (~7.5%) and ROCE (~10.4%) sit meaningfully below sector benchmark medians, meaning the growth hasn't yet translated into superior returns on capital - typical of EMS/contract-manufacturing economics where scale must be built before margins/utilisation improve. The stock has already re-rated hard, roughly 3x off its 52-week low, which narrows the margin of safety for a name that hasn't yet proven best-in-class returns.
